findings.evidence: The proof terms of `toCechCohomology_app_comp_homologyCechComplexIsoCechCohomologyOne_inv` and `toCechCohomology_app_comp_homologyCechComplexIsoCechCohomologyOneAddCommGrpCat_inv` are character-for-character the same apart from the `_hom` lemma name. Both defs are `@asIso _ _ _ _ ((toCechCohomology _ 1 U (IsOpenCover.mk hU)).app F.obj) (…)`. `homologyMap_cechComplexMap_comp_toCechCohomology_app` is already generic in `A` (Cofinal.lean, variable block line 65).
findings.fix: In `Topology/Sheaves/Cech/Cofinal.lean`, state the isomorphism, its `_hom` and the inverse-on-a-coarser-cover lemma once, for an arbitrary `A`, `n`, `P` and an `[IsIso ((toCechCohomology A n U hU).app P)]` hypothesis. Then derive the two degree one Leray versions by supplying `isIso_toCechCohomology_one_of_subsingleton_H'` or `…_addCommGrpCat` as the instance, or drop them for the general one.
findings.issue: `homologyCechComplexIsoCechCohomologyOne`/`_hom`/`toCechCohomology_app_comp_homologyCechComplexIsoCechCohomologyOne_inv` and their `…AddCommGrpCat` copies are the same constructions, each proved twice. The proof is `asIso` of `toCechCohomology … .app P` plus `Iso.comp_inv_eq` with `homologyMap_cechComplexMap_comp_toCechCohomology_app`. The only coefficient-specific input is which Leray `IsIso` theorem is used.

summary: The core results are stated at the right level: `isIso_toCechCohomology_app_of_forall_isIso` (any coefficient category, any degree, any property `L`) and `cechComplexFunctorMapHomologyIso` (any additive, homology-preserving functor), with the specializations derived from them. However, the bundled isomorphism, its `_hom` lemma and its inverse lemma in `Leray/Colimit.lean` are written twice, once for `ModuleCat` and once for `AddCommGrpCat`, with identical proofs, although nothing in them depends on the coefficients.
